evidence_for: historical records with recognized profiles were accepted only as legacy with claim_allowed=false and TOKEN_VAZIO_REVALIDATION_REQUIRED
validation stopped on GAP_TERMUX_CI_DETECTOR_PR_HEAD_20260819T1048Z because its schema field was rafaelia-operational-gap/v1 and the profile was not in the explicit allowlist
evidence_against: no evidence that the historical Termux detector record itself is malformed or unsafe; failure is limited to schema-profile recognition
failure_mode: Historical schema profile rafaelia-operational-gap/v1 was omitted from the explicit legacy schema allowlist, causing fail-closed rejection after otherwise valid historical records passed
falsifier: After adding only the explicit historical profile, the same record is still rejected as unknown schema or any new malformed current-schema record is incorrectly accepted
next_probe: Run operational-gap-assurance on the corrective branch and require all historical profiles to remain claim_allowed=false/TOKEN_VAZIO_REVALIDATION_REQUIRED while current malformed records still fail

mitigation.action: add rafaelia-operational-gap/v1 only to the explicit legacy schema set; do not broaden wildcard acceptance and do not rewrite historical records
mitigation.rollback: revert the single allowlist entry if terminal validation reveals over-acceptance

closure_gate.criterion: terminal operational-gap-assurance succeeds with the historical profile explicitly accepted and anti-promotion invariant preserved
closure_gate.evidence_needed: workflow run id, job id, Validate operational gap records step SUCCESS, and logs showing legacy_accepted=true with claim_allowed=false for the target profile
closure_gate.falsifier: unknown/new malformed schemas pass or target historical profile remains rejected

review_or_expiry: revalidate whenever operational-gap schema vocabulary or record gate changes

detector.signal: unknown operational-gap schema emitted by operational_gap_record_gate.py
detector.threshold: any record in data/routing/operational-gaps is rejected solely because an already-observed historical schema vocabulary is missing from the explicit compatibility table
detector.false_positive: a genuinely unknown or malformed schema is mistaken for a historical profile
detector.false_negative: a historical profile is accepted without claim_allowed=false or without TOKEN_VAZIO_REVALIDATION_REQUIRED
detector.evidence_needed: record schema/schema_version, gate JSON output, workflow exit code and log

safety_assurance.data_acquisition: scan every operational-gap JSON through the explicit record gate
safety_assurance.analysis: separate canonical validation from explicit historical compatibility and reject unknown vocabularies
safety_assurance.system_reassessment: on each schema change, rerun all historical records and negative malformed fixtures
safety_assurance.corrective_trigger: new current-schema record bypasses canonical validator or legacy record receives closure/PASS semantics

learning.reusable_control: schema vocabulary is itself a lifecycle component; historical compatibility must be explicit, narrow, fail-closed and non-promotional
learning.index_or_test: maintain explicit historical schema fixtures and receipt for each compatibility addition
learning.recurrence_check: next assurance run must prove both target acceptance and unknown-schema rejection
